name: Undo

guide.summary: Go back to just before your last change.
guide.biology: A game tool with no lab analogue: real time cannot be rewound.
guide.rules: Undo restores the dish to the moment just before your most recent completed change, including the time that has passed since: Undo rewinds time. One level is kept per dish. Taking a sample is not an undo point (Cancel puts it back instead).
guide.example: Paint a wall by mistake, then Undo: the wall is gone and the clock is back where it was.

changes: Everything in the dish returns to how it was just before your last change, time included.
doesNotChange: Your saves and your other dishes.
watchFor: The clock going back to the moment before your change.
